summary: Folded the Unity documentation tools from the NCP project's local extension into the gizmo-registry Unity package, copied the source into packages/unity/src/server/docs, renamed the default export to registerUnityDocs, wired it into the Unity Pi extension, added dependencies, and wrote a vitest covering the registered tools and commands. Fixed TS2741 errors by adding details: undefined to onUpdate payloads so pnpm check/build/test all passed (35 files, 107 tests), then committed and re-published the registry. Deleted the old .pi/extensions/unity-docs directory from the NCP project (deletions pending) and verified unity_docs_status ran against Unity 6000.3.10f1.
decisions: Moved Unity docs tooling from a standalone extension into the @gizmo/unity package under packages/unity/src/server/docs, so it ships as part of the Unity extension rather than a separate one.
Renamed the default export to registerUnityDocs and invoked it from extensions/unity/pi-extension.ts instead of letting it self-register.
Added @earendil-works/pi-coding-agent, @earendil-works/pi-ai, and typebox to packages/unity/package.json as runtime dependencies.
Fixed onUpdate payload type errors by including details: undefined to satisfy the AgentToolResult type.

Committed registry changes as 229a0ce 'feat: fold Unity documentation tools into Unity extension' plus a docs follow-up commit, then re-issued a registry.update over the WebSocket so the agent-server picks up the new build.
errors: pnpm check failed with TS2741 'Property details is missing' at three onUpdate call sites in packages/unity/src/server/docs/index.ts; resolved by adding details: undefined to each onUpdate payload, after which check/test/build all passed.
